comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Doc comments for parameters, return values and errors
themes.text: A doc comment can describe each parameter with `@param`, the return value with `@return` and each error with `@throws`. The compiler checks each tag against the method, and the editor shows the sentences.
